name: Unnerving Silence

angles.text: As a druid, you may worry for your kin and the balance of the wild when a secluded enclave in Shadowgale Forest falls silent. Finding Elegael Thornpaw may reveal what disrupted their communion.

faq.answer: You are asked to learn why messages from a druid conclave in Shadowgale Forest have stopped. Search the cave in the forest's northeast and discover what has happened to the secluded order.
faq.q: What is the quest Unnerving Silence about?

faq.answer: Elegael Thornpaw is in a cave in northeastern Shadowgale Forest. She is the point of contact for the secluded druid conclave there.
faq.q: Where can Elegael Thornpaw be found?

faq.answer: Elegael Thornpaw belongs to the druid conclave in a cave in northeastern Shadowgale Forest. Her silence and the missed scheduled messages have raised concern for the enclave's safety.

Shadowgale Forest is a wooded expanse with a hidden druid conclave in a cave in its northeastern region. Since Ban'aethall fell and turmoil spread through the territory, contact with the forest's people has grown uncertain.
Ban'aethall was a village deep in Shadowgale Forest, now fallen into ruin. Its destruction and unrest across the territory have raised fears for nearby camps, including the Shadowgale conclave.

aliases: why did druids stop sending messages
faq.answer: The druids' scheduled messages and reports from Shadowgale Forest have stopped without explanation. With Ban'aethall in ruins and tension rising, their allies fear disaster or hostile forces may have overtaken the enclave.
faq.q: Why has the druid conclave gone silent?

sections.body: After Ban'aethall fell into ruin, unrest stirred through the territory. Regular messages from the druid conclave in a cave in northeastern Shadowgale Forest have now stopped. Their allies have heard nothing, and worry grows as the forest grows more unsettled.
sections.title: Silence in the Canopy

sections.body: You are sent into northeastern Shadowgale Forest to find Elegael Thornpaw, a prominent druid of the enclave. Has the conclave withdrawn deeper into communion with nature, or have the dangers that tore through Ban'aethall reached the cave? No one knows the enclave's fate.
sections.title: Seeking the Enclave

summary: In northeastern Shadowgale Forest, a druid enclave has gone silent. Since Ban'aethall fell into ruin, unrest has spread through the territory.
